description: This file defines the interface and class declarations for a GStreamer Web Audio Player component within the Rialto media server. It includes class definitions for the factory and the player itself, along with method declarations for controlling playback, setting configurations, and managing the pipeline.

classes.name: GstWebAudioPlayerFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating instances of GstWebAudioPlayer.

classes.name: GstWebAudioPlayer
classes.description: Main class implementing the Web Audio Player functionality, managing GStreamer pipeline, and handling playback controls.

methods.name: createGstWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new GstWebAudioPlayer instance.

methods.name: setCaps
methods.description: Sets the audio capabilities and configuration for the player.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data buffers to the pipeline.

methods.name: getQueuedBytes
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes queued in the pipeline.

methods.name: stopWorkerThread
methods.description: Stops and resets the worker thread.

methods.name: createAmlhalaSink
methods.description: Creates an AML HALA sink element.

methods.name: createRtkAudioSink
methods.description: Creates an RTK audio sink element.

methods.name: createAutoSink
methods.description: Creates an auto audio sink element.

methods.name: linkElementsToSrc
methods.description: Links sink and conversion elements to the source.

methods.name: termWebAudioPipeline
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up the WebAudio pipeline.
